portfolio.name: Synthetic long/short portfolio
portfolio.description: Synthetic demo: fictional companies, prices and holdings. These results do not represent a real investment strategy.
portfolio.pnl_method: P&L uses previous-close shares × price change, divided by fixed notional. Holdings are marked after rebalancing every 21 weekdays. Costs are 5 basis points of traded notional. No dividends or corporate actions are simulated, so adjusted and original prices coincide.
